name: dental-clinic-management-system
description: Dental Clinic Management System — React + Vite frontend, Express REST API, PostgreSQL

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
